key_points: Argus raised Amgen's stock price target on pipeline strength, signaling positive investor sentiment

Phase 3 trial for dazodalibep met primary endpoint in Sjogren's disease, demonstrating promising clinical data

Combined pipeline strength and clinical trial success create a bullish thesis for long-term growth
